scope: Projection of an existing original loaded-graph execution receipt; not a fresh execution and not limited to the released query projection.

results.query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#117'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, ai.agendaNumber ORDER BY ai.agendaNumber, a.sequence LIMIT 15
MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content, c.hasConsensus ORDER BY c.sequence LIMIT 10
MATCH (wa:WorkingAssumption)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#115'}) RETURN wa.resolutionId, wa.content ORDER BY wa.sequence LIMIT 15

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE (ai.agendaNumber = '8.11' OR ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '8.11.') AND ai.meetingNumber = '117' MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, r.content ORDER BY r.sequence LIMIT 15

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, r.sequence LIMIT 10

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH wi, r, m RETURN wi.workItemCode AS workItemId, r.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber <> 'UNKNOWN' RETURN ai.agendaNumber, ai.meetingNumber, count(r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2508373'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content
MATCH (a:Agreement {resolutionId: 'AGR-132-8.13.2-004'})-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, t.tdocNumber, t.title

MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting), (a)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WHERE toLower(a.content) CONTAINS 'comeback' RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber, t.title, a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.canonicalMeetingNumber DESC, t.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber, a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, a.sequence LIMIT 10

MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc) WITH count(t) AS totalTdocs MATCH (c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})<-[:SUBMITTED_BY]-(t:Tdoc)<-[:REFERENCES]-(r:Resolution) WITH totalTdocs, count(DISTINCT t) AS resolvedTdocs RETURN totalTdocs, resolvedTdocs, round(100.0 * resolvedTdocs / totalTdocs, 1) AS ratio

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi, c, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC WITH wi, collect({company: c.companyName, count: cnt})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN wi.workItemCode, topCompanies LIMIT 5

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WHERE c.companyName IN ['Huawei', 'Ericsson'] RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(DISTINCT r) AS resCount ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

MATCH (r2:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'}) MATCH (r2)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH c, m, count(DISTINCT r2) AS companyCount MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m) WITH c, m, companyCount, count(DISTINCT r) AS total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS { (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc) } THEN r END) AS linked RETURN c.companyName AS company, m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, companyCount, linked, total, round(100.0 * companyCount / linked, 1) AS shareOfLinked ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC

MATCH (r:Resolution) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' ELSE coalesce(r.resolutionScope, 'Resolution') END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'}) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' ELSE coalesce(r.resolutionScope, 'Resolution') END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2600228'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'FFS' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS resolutionCount ORDER BY resolutionCount DESC LIMIT 10
MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(a) AS agrCount ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC
MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum, count(c) AS conCount ORDER BY mNum DESC, meeting DESC
